title: Specialize legacy prepared-piece construction for its sole UTF-8 caller
evidence: Full bodies inspected. Serena references identify PreparedContent::utf8 as the sole from_encoded caller; rg confirms the private helpers have no other construction path.
ComposerV1 exclusively uses ComposerV1Fold. PreparedPiece::ImageMarker is never constructed, while chunks.rs retains its full marker emission branch and mixed-range segmentation.
UTF8 always supplies one whole-text range, encoding Utf8V1, atom_count=1, zero markers, seed marker digest, no maximum label and break_before=false.
proposal: Remove the unused marker variant and specialize the legacy helper to borrowed &str UTF8 chunking. Derive each text span directly from the exact chunk range. Eliminate the PreparedPiece/PreparedTextRange vector and generic mixed-piece intersection logic, retaining canonical chunks, hashes, checked ordinals, UTF8 boundaries and empty-input semantics.
required_contract_changes: None. Preserve existing API, exact V7 bytes, typed failure/custody and resource bounds.

estimated_net_lines.basis: About 250 legacy range/type/branch/construction lines become a focused ~90-125 line UTF8 path; reserve integration and parity checks. No ComposerV1 fold or published API removal.

verification: Compare exact chunks, content IDs, summaries, span/piece digests and boundaries for empty text and text around 65,536-byte Unicode cuts.
Retain ComposerV1 multi-marker/fragmentation and independent complete decoder tests.
